step_1_costs_at_corpus_ranks.note: Corpus convention across every cached scenario in data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json is ranks Q5 W5 E5 R3 at level 18.

step_2_decompose_both_values.method: Solve 60a + 100b + 50c + 100d = V over non-negative integers for V = 530 and V = 590.
step_2_decompose_both_values.conclusion: Every solution family is identical between the two values except that the Dark Sphere count `a` increases by exactly 1. The 60-mana delta is one additional Dark Sphere cast at rank 5 - it cannot be a double-charged W (that would be +100 at rank 5), a double-charged E (+50) or a double-charged R (+100).

step_3_window_reconstruction.model_old: plain-cooldown Dark Sphere, N_Q = floor(T / c_Q) + 1 per docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 1.1, with c_Q = 7 x 100/(100 + R-passive haste)
step_3_window_reconstruction.sweep: T scanned 2.0-120.0 s in 0.1 s steps x R-passive haste in {0, 10, 20, 30}; solved for total = 530
step_3_window_reconstruction.result: 107 hits, all with the identical cast vector (N_Q, N_W, N_E, N_R) = (3, 2, 1, 1); window T is 14.0-14.9 s at 0 haste, 12.8-14.9 s at 10, 11.7-14.9 s at 20, 10.8-14.9 s at 30
step_3_window_reconstruction.reading: The old value is the plain-cooldown Dark Sphere schedule (one sphere at t=0, then one per recharge). The new value is the same fight with one extra Dark Sphere.

step_4_is_the_extra_sphere_correct.argument: Yes. The scenario is tagged 60, at or above the 40-Splinter Transcendent threshold at which the cached wiki text makes Dark Sphere a charge ability stocking up to 2 charges (rechargeRate 7 s, charge pips under the health bar, and the ammo atom classifying it as 'stocked ability casts'). A charge ability entering a window with 2 stocked charges produces casts = floor(T / recharge) + 2, versus floor(T / cooldown) + 1 for the same ability on a plain cooldown: exactly one more cast in any bounded window. A stock of 2 whose second charge could not be spent ahead of the 7 s recharge would be a mechanically inert mechanic, contradicting the cached description and the ammo classification.
step_4_is_the_extra_sphere_correct.cost_of_the_extra_cast: Charges do not waive the cost: Dark Sphere's cost entry is per cast, 60 mana at rank 5.

step_5_sanity_checks.mana_pool: Level-18 mana = 480 + 40 x 17 x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x 17) = 480 + 680 x 1.0 = 1160. 590 < 1160, so resource_spent is not clamped by the pool at either value, and 530 was not a clamp artifact.
step_5_sanity_checks.gross_not_net: Transcendent restores 20:255 mana per Splinter collected (255 at level 18). Both 530 and 590 are exact sums of listed cast costs, so this leaf is gross mana spent; the passive's restore does not enter it, and no restore-accounting change can explain a clean +60.
step_5_sanity_checks.w_recast_ruled_out: Force of Will's recast (the throw) has no separate cost entry in the cache; a bug charging W twice would move the total by 100 at rank 5, not 60.

limitations: The scenario definition (fight duration, ranks, items, champion options, cast order) lives outside the permitted evidence tree, so the fight window was reconstructed rather than read. The reconstruction is insensitive to which window it is: every window consistent with the old value carries the same cast vector (3, 2, 1, 1), and the ruling rests on the rank-5 cast-cost decomposition plus the cached Transcendent charge text, neither of which depends on the window.
Per runbook, no external wiki or web source was fetched; all quotes are from the HEAD export of data/ and docs/math-foundations.md.
